A 66-year-old woman with heart failure has 2 weeks of increasing exertional dyspnea; RR 22, SpO2 93%. Right lower chest: flat, dull percussion note, reduced fremitus, absent breath sounds. Upright film: right costophrenic angle blunted, a curved upper edge climbing the lateral chest wall.
Wedge resection: tumor under 3 cm made entirely of dysplastic cells creeping along intact alveolar septa in a single scale-like layer, non-mucinous; no stromal, vascular or pleural invasion.
